attributes.action: Protect Animals: Strengthen the Laws Governing Animal Breeding and Sales
attributes.additional_details: Irresponsible breeding and selling can leave animals vulnerable to neglect, poor health and suffering. After bringing home my 8 week old puppy Kiara, she required veterinary care and more than 70 ticks were found on her causing her anaemia. Her first vaccination also had to be delayed due to diarrhoea, sickness and a compromised immune system. I believe stronger laws, traceability, inspections and enforcement are needed to protect animals before they suffer.
attributes.background: We NEED the government to Strengthen animal welfare laws to prevent irresponsible breeding and selling, improve traceability and make enforcement more effective across the UK.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Strengthen UK animal welfare laws on breeding, sales, and cruelty bans for life" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/770607
